Preserve raw durations and every outside byte; no emitter authentication, performance, resource or timeout claim.

Only seconds in the five named constructed repository-cost metrics; finite and nonnegative, actual raw values retained. Preserve all counters and source/result fields, and independently recheck original counter assertions. The producer does not use these seconds for acceptance or a budget gate.

Five exact source-derived build root roles, their ten package and seventeen checksum progress operands, two actual install destination roles, and two source-pack output roles. Keep occurrence/order, suffixes, filenames, semantic digests, options and every other byte. Original tests consume and remove these temporary artifacts; persistent declared dist/repro outputs are separately received.

Only the received exact temporary historical-source and constructed-repository prefixes of the three source-owned continuity composition calls. Preserve the six historical member names/bytes/modes/hashes/seals, startup, status and all command ordering. No authentic host admission or currentness transfer.

Only the single source-owned turn fixture prefix inside outputs of the exact sixty-nine ordered cases, constrained to that case or its copied skill component. Keep all diagnostics, relative suffixes, actual exits, authority fields, expected results and case population.

Only the coupled source-generated run and claim allocation component in the unique two-row D48 result-prefix report. Require exact result.json then result.tmp roles, unchanged counters and completed/serialized equality; preserve the original effect-set assertions and all other output.

The two explicitly published pending-fixture evidence roots are independent role names only after full original and retained no-follow censuses and report.json/stdout binding. Unknown references refuse; all other raw artifact bytes remain meaningful.

Only finite nonnegative elapsed_seconds in every fully bound source-owned process record. Keep raw durations, exact argv/action/exit/streams/preimages and source timeouts. No product bound or process timeout is discharged by the quotient.

Compare each captured before/after namespace, kind, mode and raw-validated bytes/digest. Keep the full raw equality assertion for each original status/refusal window. Between independent fixtures, rename inode baselines and time baselines while preserving per-path within-call identity equality/change and timestamp equality/order. Reject inode aliases in each observed namespace. Retain all raw physical values; do not assert cross-call lifetime, birth identity or actual native authority.

Rename exactly one before-replace pending tempfile suffix, preserving the complete file population and bytes. Tie it to the actual exit91 process preimage, exact revision/version successor with no other changes, and the following successful resume after-preimage. No missing, extra or unbound atomic residue is ignored.

After raw receiving, recompute only whole stdout/stderr hashes and the known binding-file physical snapshot bytes/hash affected by the declared field relations. Stream copies are re-bound to actual raw records before their normalized replacements. Compare every referent. All inherited finite dependent-digest rules and limitations remain byte-identical and unchanged.
